 Remember the Raichand House from K3G? Airbnb brings the iconic home to life
 The experience marks 25 years of K3G, with 180 invitations available for fans to revisit the film's iconic moments.
 afaqs! news bureau 
 19 Nov 2026 
 12:43
 IST Follow Us
 New Update Twenty-five years after Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (K3G) introduced audiences to the lavish Raichand household, Airbnb is bringing the fictional home to life in Mumbai.
 The company has recreated the iconic Raichand House as part of an exclusive two-hour experience titled 'At Home with the Raichands'. The experience will run from December 1-6, 2026, and will be hosted by Poo (Kareena Kapoor), Rohan Raichand (Hrithik Roshan)  and filmmaker Karan Johar, who directed the 2001 film.
 View this post on Instagram 
The recreation will feature several recognisable elements from the film, including the grand staircase, family study and Poo's iconic wardrobe. Guests will also be taken through the house via an immersive audio tour revisiting some of the film's memorable moments.
The experience will include a traditional Raichand-style welcome, an entry challenge involving a tongue twister, access to Poo's recreated closet and a note-writing activity inspired by the film's themes of love and family. Guests will also receive a keepsake from their visit.
 Karan Johar said the recreation offers fans an opportunity to experience a world they have spent years imagining. He added that the film continues to find audiences among younger generations, who recreate its dialogues, fashion moments and characters.
 Hrithik Roshan, who played Rohan Raichand, said reconnecting with the film's team after 25 years brought back memories. Kareena Kapoor, who played Poo, said the character continues to resonate with a new generation of audiences.
 Amanpreet Singh Bajaj, country head, Airbnb India and Southeast Asia, said the initiative aims to bring fans closer to a fictional home they have grown up feeling connected to.
 How to book the experience
 Booking requests for 'At Home with the Raichands' will open on November 23, 2026, at 12 PM IST, through Airbnb's website. The experience is priced at Rs. 0, with only 180 invitations available.
 Each booking covers one guest and one companion. Guests will have to arrange their own travel to and from Mumbai. They must also have an active Airbnb profile, a history of positive reviews on the platform and a government-issued identity document.
 However, the experience does not include appearances by Karan Johar, Kareena Kapoor or Hrithik Roshan.
 The initiative marks Airbnb's latest attempt to bring popular cultural worlds into real-life experiences, using the 25th anniversary of one of Hindi cinema's most recognisable family dramas as its hook
